2607.22766.title: Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
2607.22766.paper_summary: The alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by data quality. As datasets scale, massive preference and instruction-tuning corpora inevitably accumulate hidden structural contradictions, safety risks, and systemic human annotation errors. Standard dataset auditing methods, such as semantic deduplication or LLM-as-a-judge, struggle to capture the actual predictive impact of individual records and often miss deep functional rule clashes. To address this, we introduce a scalable, inference-only data valuation pipeline that approximates the Shapley value without iterative model retraining. By mapping semantic k-NN neighborhoods into a directed graph, our framework evaluates data utility directly through a reference LLM's probability distribution using zero-shot and one-shot conditional log-likelihood shifts. Our pipeline then translates these predictive influence scores into localized advantage metrics to isolate gradient-conflicting records. We demonstrate the pipeline's efficacy in sanitizing two heavily vetted alignment datasets. First, applying our pipeline to the HelpSteer2 dataset reduced the manual audit search space by 99.1%, successfully uncovering falsely-labeled records across diverse failure modes. Second, applying our automated audit strategy to Anthropic's HH-RLHF training and evaluation splits identified thousands of hidden safety and factual preference inversions. Crucially, by extending this audit to the evaluation split, we expose severe vulnerabilities in current benchmark integrity: highly capable models frequently predict the safer or more helpful response, only to be penalized by objectively flawed human ground-truth labels. Overall, our work provides a mathematically grounded, highly efficient diagnostic tool to uncover human label failures, sanitize evaluation benchmarks, and ensure the integrity of LLM alignment data.
2607.22766.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）的對齊越來越受到數據質量的瓶頸限制。隨著數據集的擴大，大量的偏好和指令調整語料庫不可避免地積累了隱藏的結構矛盾、安全風險和系統性的人類標註錯誤。標準數據集審核方法，如語義去重或LLM作為評判者，難以捕捉單個記錄的實際預測影響，並且經常錯過深層功能規則的衝突。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了一個可擴展的僅推斷數據評估管道，該管道在不進行迭代模型再訓練的情況下近似Shapley值。通過將語義k-NN鄰域映射到有向圖，我們的框架通過參考LLM的概率分佈直接評估數據效用，使用零-shot和one-shot條件對數似然變化。我們的管道然後將這些預測影響分數轉換為局部優勢指標，以隔離梯度衝突的記錄。我們展示了該管道在清理兩個經過嚴格審核的對齊數據集中的有效性。首先，將我們的管道應用於HelpSteer2數據集，將人工審核搜索空間減少了99.1%，成功發現了各種失敗模式下的錯誤標記記錄。其次，將我們的自動審核策略應用於Anthropic的HH-RLHF訓練和評估拆分，識別了數千個隱藏的安全和事實偏好反轉。關鍵是，通過將這一審核擴展到評估拆分，我們揭示了當前基準完整性中的嚴重漏洞：高能力模型經常預測更安全或更有幫助的回應，卻因客觀缺陷的人類真實標籤而受到懲罰。總的來說，我們的工作提供了一個數學基礎的、高效的診斷工具，以揭示人類標籤失敗、清理評估基準，並確保LLM對齊數據的完整性。
